usage: music-tagger write-tags [-h] --diff DIFF_FILE [--dry-run]
                               [--approve-overwrites] [--log LOG | --no-log]

Apply tag changes from a diff JSON.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --diff DIFF_FILE      Diff JSON from `diff` (possibly LLM-edited).
  --dry-run             Show what would change without writing.
  --approve-overwrites  Allow overwrites of non-empty title, artist, album,
                        albumartist, or date.
  --log LOG             Append changes to this log file (default:
                        $MUSIC_TAGGER_LOG, else ~/Projects/music-
                        tagger/changes.log).
  --no-log              Do not write the change log.
